title: When it is all too much
line: For overwhelm, exhaustion, and needing calm.
intro: When everything is too much, the first thing is to slow down. This practice is mostly breath, with Vishnu, who rests at the centre of everything, untroubled.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Just breathe. In as the circle grows, out as it settles. Nothing else is needed for now.

steps.title: Peace
steps.text: Vishnu, the very form of peace, resting on the serpent of time.

steps.title: One thing
steps.prompt: What is the one thing that matters most today? What can wait?

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: Rest is part of practice. If overwhelm does not lift, please talk to someone; Tele-MANAS is free on 14416.
